positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and deployed a full-stack transaction processing system based on PostgreSQL/Supabase with a Retool frontend, replacing 80+ interlinked spreadsheet workflow alongside handling migration of client data.
Engineered SQL triggers for regular caching of account balances and automated fee generation for each transaction.
Built an end-to-end intelligence pipeline for the firm. Transformed their email archive (100K+ messages) into a structured, entity-resolved corpus, an identity/relationship graph validated against independent data sources, an LLM-based knowledge extraction pipeline, along with a LanceDB-based RAG layer for custom Q&A retrieval.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and deployed a full-stack web application with Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, allowing users in NYC to browse and post free items via an interactive Leaflet.js map.
Containerized the application with Docker multi-stage builds and Docker Compose, decoupling frontend and backend into isolated services with persistent volumes.
Replaced duplicated user data in listing records with ID references resolved through GraphQL, so 500+ existing listings always display current user profiles without needing a schema migration.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Led end-to-end development of a scalable transportation scheduling platform for a Brooklyn non-profit, engineering the system with React/TypeScript, Node.js/Express, and MongoDB to securely support 100+ active users across NYC.
Architected and deployed 20+ secure REST API endpoints backed by a 5-layer middleware stack, built for fault tolerance and scalability under concurrent load.
Integrated third-party microservices (Twilio, Google Maps) to power real-time logistics tracking and automated notifications, enforcing access control and security standards through a role-based React Admin interface.
